A patch release that adds a sort menu to the web UI.

## New

- **Sort the issues inside each wave.** The new **Sort** menu orders the issues inside each wave on the Graph and Execution order tabs by **issue number** (the default), **last updated**, **prerequisite count**, **dependent count**, or the **execution order**. The choice lives in the URL (`?sort=`), so a shared link keeps it. Each wave keeps its column, its header and its number, and an issue with no reported update time sorts last. ([#110](https://github.com/brunoorsolon/forge-desk/issues/110))
- **`updatedAt` on every plan node.** The plan API and the web snapshot now report each issue's last update time (`updatedAt`, ISO 8601, or `null` when the tracker reports none), which is what **last updated** sorts by.

## Upgrading from 2.0.2

The content hash of every view changes, because `updatedAt` is now part of the plan. Nothing else to change.
